name: @visuelconcept-winccoa/wui-auth-badge
description: Badge login for the WebUI shell — a login provider's login extension: an RFID reader in keyboard emulation, badge → user through the RFID_UID user setting, a user's badge locked after N refused logins (kept in their user settings, on every station; unknown badges only audited), an audit line per event, every session's close audited through the shell's logout hook (POST /logout); "Mon badge" (/auth-badge) lets a user associate their badge when self-service is on; "Badges" (/auth-badge/admin), by Application Security role, turns the badge login on or off, opens or closes self-service, stores the numbers as one-way fingerprints (HMAC-SHA256), sets the lock's threshold and duration, enrols any user's badge, tests that a badge opens their session and unlocks a locked user with a reason; "Switch user" in the menu.

notes: reader frame prefix: WUI_BADGE_PREFIX in the webserver's environment, until one is saved on Badges
audit lines go to an _AuditTrail DP, when it exists: auditDp in the [wui-auth] section of config/config (auditDp = "AuditTrail_MSP"), else WUI_AUTH_AUDIT_DP, else AuditTrail_Auth

settings (badge login enabled, self-service enrolment, the reader's frame: prefix, burst, minimum length, end key, the lock's threshold and duration) in the DP WuiAuthBadge_Config.settings, its type and DP created at the first change
each user's badge lock (refused logins in a row, locked until) in their user setting BADGE_LOCK (_usr_<UserId>_BADGE_LOCK), created at first need

badge numbers as fingerprints (hashBadges): the HMAC key is WUI_BADGE_HASH_KEY, else config/wui-auth-badge.key (generated at the first activation) — back it up with the project, without it the hashed badges must be enrolled again
